findings.summary: The Modal close button is a bare ✕ glyph with no icon-button class, no aria-label, and the wrapper lacks role="dialog"/aria-modal, unlike the sibling Dialog primitive.
findings.fix: Match RecruitmentPage's Dialog: add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" to the outer div, and replace <button onClick={close}>✕</button> with <button className="icon-button" onClick={close} aria-label="إغلاق"><X className="size-5" /></button> (import X from lucide-react).

findings.summary: Loading state is a plain text "جارٍ التحميل…" paragraph instead of the app's skeleton pattern used by sibling pages, causing a jarring layout shift when data arrives.
findings.fix:

findings.summary: The Modal cannot scroll tall content and clips on small viewports because it lacks the max-h/overflow-y-auto the sibling Dialog uses.
findings.fix: Change the inner section to <section className="card max-h-[94vh] w-full max-w-2xl overflow-y-auto p-6"> so long forms (e.g. the course form) remain fully reachable on short screens.

findings.summary: The two form submit buttons give no in-flight/disabled feedback while the upsert/enroll mutations run, so users can double-submit.
findings.fix: Reflect mutation pending state on the submit buttons, e.g. <button className="btn-primary" disabled={commands.upsertCourse.isPending}>{commands.upsertCourse.isPending ? 'جارٍ الحفظ…' : 'حفظ'}</button>, and likewise for the enroll button using commands.enroll.isPending.

findings.summary: The modal overlay uses a hardcoded Tailwind color bg-slate-950/60 instead of a design token, and there is no Escape-to-close handler.
findings.fix: Mirror the sibling Dialog exactly (which is the accepted app pattern); if tightening further, drive the overlay from a token-based scrim, and optionally add an onKeyDown Escape handler on the dialog wrapper.

findings.summary: The mandatory checkbox row (label className="flex gap-2") is not vertically aligned, leaving the checkbox and its text baseline mismatched.
findings.fix: Add items-center to the checkbox label: <label className="flex items-center gap-2">…دورة إلزامية</label>.

findings.summary: LearningPage defines its own local Field/Modal helpers that duplicate the labeled-input and dialog patterns already established in sibling pages (e.g. RecruitmentPage's Input/Select/Dialog).
findings.fix: Where practical, reuse a shared labeled-field/dialog primitive rather than re-declaring Field and Modal per page, to keep spacing (mb-1.5, p-6, max-w) and a11y attributes uniform across management pages.
